spells.name: Precision Lance
spells.intendedResponse: Keep moving: it is aimed where you are going, so change direction or jump as the line locks.
spells.countersAndWeaknesses: One narrow projectile; a change of direction after the line locks makes it miss. Punishes standing still and slow recovery.
spells.knownLimitations: A single raw projectile is capped at the engine's raw speed (9 px/frame): long range gives time to react by design.

spells.name: Converging Volley
spells.intendedResponse: They all meet at the marked point: leave it — sideways, or jump over the meeting point.
spells.countersAndWeaknesses: All six converge on one point chosen when they launch; anywhere outside the mark is safe.
spells.knownLimitations: The six arrows only converge on the point chosen at launch; a player already outside the mark is safe.

spells.name: Heavy Orb
spells.intendedResponse: Slow and huge: keep the drawn burst circle off you — walk away from it, or get past it.
spells.countersAndWeaknesses: It moves at a third of your speed; it bursts only when within 90 px of you.
spells.knownLimitations: Slow by design; in a confined room it can corner a player who does not move early.

spells.name: Watching Shard
spells.intendedResponse: While the shard watches, attacking or casting releases it at you — wait it out (5 s), or attack and dodge at once.
spells.countersAndWeaknesses: It only reacts to you attacking or casting (the same thing a forge spell can see), and it flies straight at where you are then.
spells.knownLimitations: Reacts only to "target attacks or casts" (castTimer / melee attack in the game); a player who never attacks is never struck.

spells.name: Delayed Crossfire
spells.intendedResponse: Three shots on three fuses: dodge each as its fuse runs out — dodging only the first is not enough.
spells.countersAndWeaknesses: Each spike is aimed when its own fuse ends; a change of direction between fuses beats the next one.
spells.knownLimitations: Aimed at the lagged perception of the player, three times; wall-hugging shortens the dodge room.

spells.name: Saturation Stream
spells.intendedResponse: The stream follows you slowly: keep running one way, or cut back through behind it.
spells.countersAndWeaknesses: Its aim lags (it sweeps toward you); a steady run outpaces it. Long range only.
spells.knownLimitations: Paid from his reserve through owner.drain (240 E per cast); the cursor lags on purpose so a steady run outpaces it.

spells.name: Branching Pursuit
spells.intendedResponse: Two arrows covering two escapes: the first where you are heading, the second where you tend to dodge to. Break your habit.
spells.countersAndWeaknesses: The second branch reads your usual dodge (toward / away / up). Do something else, or stand your ground between them.
spells.knownLimitations: The second branch reads the player's observed habit (EMA of dodge direction); a player with no habit gets a guess.

spells.name: Expanding Burst
spells.intendedResponse: Get out of the drawn ring before it fills (about 1.1 s from the first glow).
spells.countersAndWeaknesses: Only reaches the ring; he is rooted while it builds, so it is also an opening from outside the ring.
spells.knownLimitations: Short range only (≤ 320 px); the ring drawn is the measured burst radius.

spells.name: Gilded Ward
spells.intendedResponse: Back off from the ring of motes before it bursts; his guard only blunts damage, so keep attacking from range.
spells.countersAndWeaknesses: The motes burst at 3.5 s around him; the reinforcement lowers damage, it does not stop it.
spells.knownLimitations: Raw reinforcement: the engine gives ≈ 25–30 % damage resistance; not immunity.

spells.name: Lattice of Mines
spells.intendedResponse: Mines settle in a line: stay in the lanes between them; do not walk into the drawn circles.
spells.countersAndWeaknesses: They only burst when you come within 110 px; lanes of ≈ 100 px between bursts are always safe.
spells.knownLimitations: Mines are anchored for up to 11 s (his tidy rule) and only burst within 110 px.

spells.name: Absolute Output
spells.intendedResponse: A long, loud wind-up: when the sphere splits, sidestep the lance, slip between the ring shards and outrun the slow core.
spells.countersAndWeaknesses: Everything leaves from one point over his head after a 1.4 s hold; he is rooted for all of it — the best opening to punish.
spells.knownLimitations: Phase III only; peak output 813 within his 960 Max Output.

spells.name: Blooming Line
spells.intendedResponse: Five small discs in a line that swell into wide bursts when they reach you: get out of the drawn bloom circles — sideways, or over the line.
spells.countersAndWeaknesses: Each disc only blooms within 110 px of you; the circles drawn round each disc are the real burst size.
spells.knownLimitations: From discovery RD-0099. The bloom happens only within 110 px of the player.

spells.name: Waiting Mines
spells.intendedResponse: Three mines settle where you were heading and wait: change course, and never run back through them.
spells.countersAndWeaknesses: They only burst within 120 px; a change of direction before they land leaves them behind you.
spells.knownLimitations: From discovery RD-0234. Anchored mines; in a confined room they deny a lot of floor for their lifetime.
